title: draw_diagram
description: Draw a diagram from a description (a process, a flow, an organisation): its boxes and the arrows between them. The application lays it out in steps (by the arrows) and styles it like the deck's own diagrams; to change one afterwards, use duplicate_shape, connect_shapes and the text tools.

slide_id.description: The slide's number or ID (make one first with add_slide when needed).

nodes.description: The boxes, numbered from 0 in this order.

edges.description: The arrows: from box n to box m.

direction.description: right: steps left to right (a flow); down: top to bottom (a hierarchy). Left out: right.

like_shape_id.description: A box on this slide to copy the look of. Left out: the deck's nearest diagram, else the theme.

box.description: The area, in fractions of the slide. Left out: under the title.
